items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Joe Comfort left to go to Lionel Hampton -- Joe Comfort left to go with Nat King Cole. And he asked me to That's when he joined the band. ... So I joined the band.

ctx.x: I was just getting started. But Joe Comfort had an electric bass, I remember that. He invented it, I think. (Inaudible), you can't sit with him. You can't sit with Charlie Christian. That's Charlie Christian up there.
